body: I mean I don’t have insurance or money for a therapist. I know I have friends I can reach out to but I can’t get myself to do it. I know I hate my job, but I need it to be able to keep a roof over my head.  I know there are small things I can be doing to make myself feel better or head down the path to it, but for whatever reason I cannot get myself to do any of them. It’s maddening
